**Root cause: `dep-4471` set `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true`.** [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md)

Each request now takes its own connection. The size-20 pool saturated 38s later.

Window: `02:14:18Z` to `03:59:27Z`, still failing. 530 of 1228 requests failed. Peak was 71%.

Rollback target is `dep-4471`, gateway config generation 119 to 118.

Raising pool size will not hold. Per-request checkout scales with traffic.

Next: roll back `dep-4471`, watch `waiting` drop to 0.
